scope: Reviewed exceptions to collect_rls_evidence.py expectations. An entry silences the listed rules for one (role, table) and is reported under 'accepted' with its reason. Anything not listed here stays a violation (exit 1).

accepted.reason: Tenant registry: the row is the tenant, so no tenant_id scope applies. 0001_s02_baseline grants SELECT to inv_app on purpose. Cross-tenant enumeration of slug/display_name remains a design observation for Codex.
0045_discovery_machine_credentials grants SELECT(tenant_id) only, to validate tenant existence while issuing machine credentials.
0045 budget guard role reads issue budgets across tenants to enforce the issuer budget trigger; it is NOLOGIN and used only by the budget trigger function.

0047 audit read role. audit_events.tenant_id is nullable because AC-02 requires keeping a credential rejection that resolved to no tenant, so a tenant predicate would hide exactly the rows this role exists to read; its policy is USING (true) by design. E2 is NOT excepted: RLS is enabled and forced. The role is NOLOGIN, NOINHERIT, NOBYPASSRLS, holds no other privilege, and the migration refuses to run if inv_app or inv_kernel is a member of it. inv_app has no SELECT on this table at all.
